_readme: Single source for the en/ site root (nav, SEO, catalog, sitemap). Human-readable fields are translation units tracked in i18n/ledger.json. Rebuild with: SITE_ROOT=en node scripts/build_nav.js

site.title: Headscale self-hosted VPN control server guide
site.subtitle: Self-hosted Tailscale control server
site.description: 12-chapter Headscale guide: install, users and preauth keys, joining devices, node management, ACL, routes, DNS, admin settings, security and troubleshooting.

chapters.title: Before you start
chapters.card: First, get clear on what Headscale is, what self-hosting the control server gets you, and how it differs from official Tailscale.
chapters.description: Headscale self-hosted VPN control server, planning before you start: why self-host, how it differs from official Tailscale, accounts and security boundaries.

chapters.title: Install Headscale
chapters.card: Install the Headscale add-on into Home Assistant and learn what state it is in right after the install.
chapters.description: Home Assistant Headscale add-on install guide: add the repository, install, start, and get ready for the first open.

chapters.title: First open and sign-in
chapters.card: Open the control interface, get to know the CLI / API and admin operations.
chapters.description: Headscale first open: the control interface, the CLI and the API, and admin operations.

chapters.title: Create a user and a preauth key
chapters.card: Create your first user, generate a preauth key, and get ready to join a device.
chapters.description: Headscale, create a user and a preauth key: namespaces (the legacy name), users and preauth keys.

chapters.title: Join your first device
chapters.card: Point the Tailscale client at Headscale, log in and join the tailnet.
chapters.description: Headscale, join a device: point the Tailscale client at your self-hosted control server, log in and verify.

chapters.title: Node management
chapters.card: List, rename, expire and remove nodes.
chapters.description: Headscale node management: list, rename, expire and remove devices.

chapters.title: ACL access control
chapters.card: Use the policy to control who can connect to whom, with minimal exposure.
chapters.description: Headscale ACL guide: policy rules, access control and minimal exposure.

chapters.title: Routes and exit nodes
chapters.card: Subnet router and exit node: bring a whole subnet home.
chapters.description: Headscale routing guide: subnet router, exit node and local network forwarding.

chapters.title: DNS and MagicDNS
chapters.card: Connect devices by name, and understand MagicDNS and custom DNS.
chapters.description: Headscale DNS guide: MagicDNS, name resolution and custom DNS settings.

chapters.title: Admin settings
chapters.card: Policy, DERP, users (namespaces) and version updates.
chapters.description: Headscale admin settings: policy, DERP, users (namespaces) and version updates.

chapters.title: Security and minimal exposure
chapters.card: Check the entry point, the keys, the ACL and how much is publicly exposed.
chapters.description: Headscale security check: the entry point, preauth keys, the ACL and minimal exposure.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting and maintenance
chapters.card: Troubleshoot devices that will not connect, offline nodes, DERP and updates.
chapters.description: Headscale troubleshooting guide: connections, offline nodes, DERP, updates and backups.

i18n._readme: hreflang is what the zh pages use to point at themselves; xDefault says which locale to point at (en or primary), and can be flipped in one line. The locale list is in i18n/locales.json.
